Title: ‎Resilio Sync App - App Store
File transfer and photo backup. Sync is the best way to transfer files between your Mac, PC, NAS, and even server. No storage limits • Sync as much data as you have on your hard drives. Automatic camera backup • Sync will back up photos and videos as soon as you take them. • You can then delete photos from your phone and save space. Direct transfers, no cloud • Your information is never stored on servers in the cloud, so nobody can access it without your permission. Any device and platform • Access folders and upload files to your tablet, PC, Mac, NAS, and even server. Supports all file types • Add photos, videos, music, docs, and PDFs from other apps to any of your synced folders. I was in need of a method for transferring large files to friends and family (20 plus GB file size) and Resillo sync for desktop is fantastic. Which is awesome for syncing photos to my pc for backup storage. As well as if I wanted to send photos and videos to my phone from my pc. All in all this platform is simply the best for sending files to and from separate devices, especially when they are very large. But after two years of using this extensively I can say confidently that, while not perfect, it’s easily the best service of its kind on the market.I dock half a star due to the steep learning curve that makes this service a daunting task for newbies and still a stiff joint for advanced users. Hoping this will be fixed in the future because I want to use this app, it has promising features, but right now it’s too slow and too inefficient to use with tens of thousands of files.Please add ability to select a photo album and include updating changed pictures that have been added or removed from the selected album. Resilio Sync is by far the best solution, provided the devices you want to sync are on at the same time. It’s a real pain to have to check 2 different locations in a sorted list of several hundred items just because I don’t know if it’s a single file or a group of files in a folder.
